messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: ALERT P1003 - High latency spike for /v1/generate in prod. p95 jumped from ~1.2s to ~5.4s over last 3m. Rate 1.2k rps. Routed to eng-oncall primary. Alert details: https://alerts.redwood.example/alerts/P1003

Alex W: I'm primary, grabbing it now — looking at traces and the runtime dashboard. Priya, if I'm pulled into customer comms ping me but you can take infra routing checks.

Priya R: on it. I'll check node-level metrics and scheduler. Can someone confirm if any deploys landed in the last 30m?

Samir: infra-oncall here — no deploys in last 45m on runtime. Seeing increased GPU memory pressure on pool-redwood-dedicated-1 and a rise in KV cache miss rate around the same time. CLI snapshot: ```mem_used_pct: 92
kv_cache_miss_rate: 0.46
queue_depth: 320```

Maria G: support-oncall — no customer error reports yet, but CS flagged slow responses in a high-traffic tenant. I've DM'd their AE for impact matrix.

Alex W: good — sounds like runtime/cache pressure. Infra, can you check the routing change from the morning? We had a traffic re-route to a new replication group. If KV miss spikes line up with that, could be TTL/rehydration storm.

Infra Oncall: I already rolled back the recent route change on the canary node group (cmd below). Monitoring for delta.
```bash
redwoodctl route update --pool pool-redwood-dedicated-1 --policy old-sticky
```
Expect reduction in cache misses in ~30s. If no improvement, we'll scale up pool by +2 nodes.

Security Oncall: ping — I'm watching auth anomalies but nothing odd so far. If you see token-related errors drop them here. Also FYI Eli K (sec backup) is OOO between 03:00-05:00 UTC today so there's a small coverage gap for sec escalations.

Priya R: rollback applied, cache-miss rate trending down to 0.12. p95 latency improving from 5.4s -> 2.1s. Will keep scaling plan on standby.

Maria G: customer AE confirms degraded experience but no data loss. I'm drafting an initial status update for affected tenants. Alex — want me to post a brief to #customers-ops?

Alex W: yes, please post a short note: cause: routing-induced cache cold starts; mitigation: route rollback & autoscale. Tagging support and infra. Use incident id IR-2026-0412.

Priya R: quick operational note — I'm taking primary for the final 20m of the shift when Alex hands off. Alex, can you confirm handoff in 10m? Also marking the incident runbook pointer: https://docs.redwood.example/runbooks/runtime-cache-miss.md

Alex W: confirmed handoff in 10m. I'll update the incident doc with what I checked and the suggested postmortem owner. Also adding runbook step we followed: ```1) check kv miss
2) rollback routing
3) monitor p95
4) scale pool if not improved```

Support Oncall: I'll monitor customer comms and escalate to CS if we need a broader notification. No immediate SLA breach but keeping a close eye.

Infra Oncall: scaling +2 nodes now to be safe. Keeping a note: investigate why rehydration TTL wasn't warmed on rollout. Opening infra ticket INF-7289.

Alex W: thanks team. Summary for handoff: primary->Priya R at 2098765442, rollback applied, cache miss down, p95 improving but still above baseline. Owner for follow-up: Priya R (runtime infra liaison) and Infra team (INF-7289). Support will coordinate customer comms (IR-2026-0412). Security watching for auth anomalies; Eli's OOO creates 2h gap (3-5 UTC) so escalate to Security Oncall if anything suspicious pops up.

Priya R: taking primary now. I'll keep the thread updated and will spin out follow-ups to INF-7289 + postmortem. :thumbsup:

Alex W: handing off. Logging out of primary for rotation. Good job everyone.

IncidentBot: Incident IR-2026-0412 created and linked to this thread. Timeline and notes can be found: https://incidents.redwood.example/IR-2026-0412

Maria G: posting customer-facing brief to #customers-ops now.

Support Oncall: noted — will keep monitoring and escalate if any SLA windows approach.

Security Oncall: standing by. If anything changes ping @Security Oncall directly.

Eli K: (away) noted the OOO, will catch up on the postmortem later.

Alex W: closing the immediate page — continued monitoring under Priya. If latency creeps back up, re-open this thread or page infra directly. :white_check_mark:
